urdu: عبدالحفیظ کاردار نے کس کھلاڑی کو 'کھیل کا سب سے پختہ اوپنر' کہا؟
english: Which player did Abdul Hafeez Kardar refer to as 'the most solid opener' in the game?
roman_1: Abdul Hafeez Kardar ne kis khiladi ko 'khel ka sab se pakka opener' kaha?

roman_3: Abdul Hafeez Kardar nay kis player ko 'khel ka sab se pacca openar' kaha?
